sources.review: Official public bulk Places GeoParquet. Provider CDLA-Permissive-2.0/Apache-2.0/CC0 obligations preserved; complete projected category slices, no web scraping or source-API workaround. Places explicitly contains no OpenStreetMap data. Exclude unknown provider licences; include agreement texts and Foursquare NOTICE with derivative extracts. Only documented release objects; no personal contacts or street addresses.
sources.attribution: Overture Maps Foundation and original per-record providers; see data/bulk/LICENSES.

category_review.note: Complete 88,418,121-place category inventory: 5,197 animation_studio; 18,621 movie_television_studio; 16,558 video_film_production. These source sectors do not imply VFX/game/capture services or a verified facility type. Broad game_publisher and broadcasting categories do not establish development/capture studios and are not published.

sources.derived_metadata_license_review: Official October 2026 Places guide pairs original provider and Overture under the same licence. Confidence-only Overture transformation metadata inherits that listed provider licence. Overture-signals status overlays are not mapped to a licence and remain research-only pending clarification.
sources.access_mode: Officially documented public S3 dataset download/query; not website crawling. Do not interpret unrelated API robots denials as permission for those APIs.

sources.review: Structured entity data only under CC0. Explicit SPARQL API, descriptive User-Agent, serial pagination, cache, bounded response sizes and stop/backoff on rate limits. Runtime endpoint robots check required; no website/API workaround when denied.
sources.attribution: Wikidata contributors (CC0); source statement is not independent operational verification.

sources.review: One selective global tag query, not world-dump bounding-box stitching or per-element harvesting. Cache snapshot; no scheduled refresh by default. Stop at 429/denial and retain partial results. Runtime robots required. Derived source shards and their modification history stay separately distributed under ODbL, with visible attribution and license fields in export. No Nominatim bulk geocoding.
